mentions.name: Reactome Biological Pathway Graph Visualizer
mentions.description: This tool visualizes biological pathways using data pulled from the Reactome knowledge graph. It experiments with different graph visualization algorithms, which are approximations to the NP-hard problem of arranging graphs so all vertices are distinct with a global minimum of overlapping edges. The next step is implementing a novel algorithm found in a dissertation that does not share its code; it is not yet deployed.
mentions.problem: Graph layout is NP-hard; existing algorithms are approximations for arranging graphs so vertices are distinct and edge overlaps are globally minimized.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a tool for visualizing biological pathways, pulling data from the Reactome knowledge graph for now.
